specification_compliance: R3-1 (I3, a held card a refresh pushed past page 1 is not counted when trashed) is fixed by c473f33/66cccd6. The `kept` set and the derived `counted` list are removed. usePagedClips.ts:110-115 now leaves out of `unnamed` only the held cards the page menu took out (`menuRemoved`). A card the server still counts stays in `items`, and the drawn count `data.count - lists.removedCount(listKey, data.items)` (Home.tsx CardShelf, ShelfPage.tsx header) drops by one when that card is later trashed. Traced: with 61 unread, after a new clip and a trash of C clip 60, the header reads 61.

R2-1 (double subtraction after a refresh) stays fixed under the new rule. A menu-trashed card that the refreshed page 1 leaves out is now dropped from `items` (menuRemoved is true), so it is no longer in the removedCount basis while `count` comes from the server, which already excludes it. Traced: with 60 drawn, trash a3, then a new clip arrives; items become [n, a1, a2, a4..a59, a60] and the count reads the server's N with no subtraction.

Follow-on paging after the change is consistent. Once a refresh drops the trashed card, removedBefore (removedCount over data.items) returns to 0, so loadMore uses the plain path `floor(items.length/pageSize)+1`, and appendUnseen drops the card the refresh kept from page 2. No skip and no repeat was found by trace.

Earlier open B findings R2-2 (e2e callout assertion guarded, Chromium only), R2-3 (re-read overrides outlive refetches), R2-4 (fetchAlignedPage overlap hidden by dedupe) and R2-6 (an emptied grouped Library draws a blank body) are untouched by these fix commits. They are not re-filed.
d978f18 changes only review records under docs/process; it changes no product code.
potential_unspecified_behavior: After a single-page refresh, a Clips shelf page still draws the held card that a new clip pushed onto server page 2, so it shows pageSize+1 cards until the next load. This was already so before the fix, and the count is now correct for it.
regression_risks: menuRemoved is read from `latest.current`, which is updated in a post-render effect, so a refresh answer uses the menu state of the last committed render. A trash committed in the same tick as the refresh answer is applied on the next refresh, not this one. Under the single-user model this has no visible effect, because the filter still hides the card.
Clips count correctness now depends on the server excluding trashed files from both `items` and `count` of the shelf answer; this was not checked against the backend.
test_coverage: The new test 'a clip a refresh pushed past the first page, trashed from the Unread page, lowers its count by one' (clipsCardMenu.test.tsx) kills the previous `kept` implementation: under it the header would stay at 62.
Removing the `!menuRemoved(...)` term from usePagedClips.ts:114 is killed by the existing 3-clip refresh-after-trash tests on Home and the Unread page (R2-1 cases): the double subtraction returns.

For the Library Ungrouped grid, `menuRemoved` affects only which held cards remain and whether loadMore takes the reread path. No count is drawn there, and no test isolates it; dropping it would only cause a harmless reread.

trajectory: This round removed state rather than adding it. In the knowledge submodule (66cccd6), c473f33 deletes the `kept` set from usePagedClips' held state. The round before had added that set to correct the R2-1 count, and it misclassified counted cards (R3-1). The round also deletes the derived `counted` list and its callers in Home.tsx and ShelfPage.tsx. In their place the hook takes one predicate, `menuRemoved`, which PageFileMenu's new `isRemoved` answers. It filters the existing `unnamed` retention, and the drawn count goes back to the plain `data.count - removedCount(items)`. The predicate is a new input threaded through useShelfData, but it reads the page menu's existing truth rather than predicting what the server counts. It replaces a prediction instead of stacking another one on top. d978f18 is a review record only. The earlier offset and total predictions in fetchAlignedPage, usePagedClips' reread path and useNotesList are unchanged by these commits.
